subject: Headphones stopped working - not sure what to do
body: Hi, I bought a pair of wireless headphones from your Ningbo Tianyi store a few months ago and now the right side has stopped working completely. No sound at all, even after charging them fully. I'm not sure if they're still under warranty or how to go about getting them fixed or replaced. Can you let me know what my options are? I don't have the receipt anymore but I might be able to find the order in my email if that helps. Thanks.
